answer: Registration is free; earning is not. Each epoch asks every key for original text on a spiral that rotates unpredictably. What cannot be bought is a jury that already trusts you. Each karst has to be earned inside a panel system that prices collusion at the loss of every seat granted. Seal 52stx.
